abstract: In the traditional cross-layer redundancy optimization allocation, the system can't fully adapt the time-varying channel, so an H-ARQ transmission mechanism based on rate less code is proposed in this paper. The source uses LT-code as error-erasure code to encode the original packets in the packet-level, every bit of one coded packets is encoded by using LT-code as error-correction code in physical layer. The Receiver can set an upper limit value of the received bits to control decoding overhead, it sends a feedback to the source when the receiver decodes all the bits of a coded packet successfully, and otherwise it will discard the coded packet and send a feedback. Simulation results show that our mechanism improves the transmission efficiency greatly comparing to the mechanism with constant rate for coding transmission.

articleTitle: The Research on the Relationship between the Industrial Water Consumption and Economic Development in China
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: After using linear, logarithmic, reciprocal, quadratic, cubic, compound, power, S, growth, index, logistic and other 11 kinds of regression equation and grey correlation degree to study the relationship between the primary, secondary and tertiary industrial water consumption and their production value, this article draw a conclusion that industrial water consumption varies along with the development of the industrial economy. Then, the conclusion that the primary industrial water consumption would decrease with the development of economy, but the secondary and tertiary industrial consumption of water are on the contrary are made by using the GM model to predict the 2011-2020 10-year period industrial water consumption. Finally, appropriate suggestions and comments are given according to the analysis results.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology in the Application of QFD to Conceptual Design of Marine Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Based on the analysis of the problems in the marine power plant traditional conceptual design process, the QFD theory was proposed to apply to the conceptual design of the marine power plant, and the application of the QFD theory to the marine power plant conceptual design process as well as related problems in the application process were deeply studied which included the construction method and the related algorithm of the requirement analysis house of quality and the preliminary design house of quality, the fuzzy synthetic evaluation method for the design of the marine power plant and etc. Through the research in the paper, it would provide a reference for the application of applying QFD to the conceptual design of the marine power plant, which would help to improve the design quality.

articleTitle: Research on GML Data Validity Verification Based on Stack Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: GML schemas are metadata files, which define the structure, content and restriction of GML instances. GML parsing establishes a good basis for future GML data studies and applications such as storage, compression, query, index and share etc. The engine for GML grammar validation is an important component of GML parser, which includes validity verification and consistency verification. The objective of validity verification is to ensure GML data to be well-formed. In this paper, the functional structure of the GML schema-based parser is discussed, and an algorithm for GML data validity verification is developed and implemented. Experimental results show that the algorithm is effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Research in the Simulation Model of IGBT Package
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Simulation technology provides a powerful tool for the IGBT module design. The IGBT chip model and the interconnect parasitics are the most important factors for the package design of IGBT module. By the aid of the simulation software, the IGBT chip model is fulfilled and the package parasitics is extracted. So the whole simulation deign platform of IGBT package achieves.

articleTitle: A Rate-Difference Based Energy-Efficient Resource Allocation Algorithm for Downlink OFDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: For the limitation of resource and the requirement of environment, energy-efficient OFDMA systems gradually play an important role in wireless communication. In this paper, we present a novel resource allocation algorithm for downlink energy-efficient OFDMA systems, under the given QoS requirement and power limitation constraints. Compared with the existing works, we propose a sub carrier and power allocation scheme from the perspective of rate-difference and suggest a simple algorithm to find the solution with fewer iteration times. The algorithm includes two parts: the Rate-Difference Based Sub carrier Assignment Algorithm (RBSA) and the Rate-Difference Based Power Allocation Algorithm (RBPA). It can be seen that the general trend of maximum energy efficiency decreases with larger ε and fluctuates between the maximum value and zero, where ε is the proportional power parameter. The simulation results show the significant improvement of energy efficiency with the proposed schemes and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Motion Controller Design of DR Camera's UC Arm
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This is a design of UC arm motion controller based on the CPLD device and ADuc831 single-chip microcomputer and serial port expansion chip TL16C554, the hardware part is made up of a single-chip microcomputer system, CPLD system, communication circuit, serial port expansion circuit, position feedback processing circuit, Motion control digital IO output circuit and so on. The hardware description language and C language are adopted for the software part, and the UC-arm motion in different axial directions and the detection of a variety of mechanical positions can achieve.

articleTitle: Ant Colony Algorithm Based on Dynamic Adaptive Pheromone Updating and Its Simulation
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In order to effectively overcome the defects of local and global pheromone updating for the basic Ant Colony Algorithm, this paper has proposed a new improved Ant Colony Algorithm based on the dynamic adaptive weight in the updating strategy. The proposed algorithm can update pheromone dynamically and adaptively according to the change of taboo lists and the quality of iteration-best solutions. By the experiments of several typical Traveling Salesman Problems (TSP), the proposed algorithm is clearly better than several other typically Ant Colony Algorithms in the convergence speed and the solution quality. The test results can reflect its effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Railway Rolling Stock Based on SOUPA Ontology
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Based on SOUPA ontology, Description Logic reasoner is adopted in fault diagnosis for railway rolling stock. Condition analyzer which performs on-board fault detection and classification for Our system is engineered to run on embedded devices that meet stringent railway regulations for on-board deployment, and thus it witnesses the feasibility of ontology-based approaches for the implementation of intelligent information systems even in contexts where memory and processing resources come at a premium.

articleTitle: A New Pre-processing Method for Infrared Images Based on Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: A new IR (infrared) image pre-processing approach based on image fusion is presented in this paper. Through analyzing the noises types of IR image, this paper produces an alpha-trimmed mean filter for suppressing mixed noises and rapid Sobel edge detector for enhancing the target's edge. Then it uses simple weight average method to fuse the treated IR image. Simulation shows that this method is applicable for real-time IR images enhancement and beneficial to target recognition.

articleTitle: Fuzzy SMC Based on Power Reaching Law with Variable Universe for Servo System
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: To decrease the influence of friction on control accuracy of electro-optical tracking servo system, the fuzzy sliding mode control (SMC) with variable universe was put forward. Firstly, based on the LuGre friction model, a sliding mode controller with power reaching law was set up, Then, to relieve the chattering problem, the fuzzy method with variable universe was used to adjust the plus of the sliding mode controller, Finally, the simulation experiment was put up to compare control accuracy of these two controllers. The simulation results show that the fuzzy sliding mode controller with variable universe not only improves the tracking accuracy, but also relieves the chattering problem substantially.

articleTitle: Virtual Calligraphic Learning and Writing Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Chinese calligraphy is received increasing attention nowadays. More and more schools open the calligraphic course and lot of foreigners start to learn calligraphy. The learning procedure is time costing and it is necessary that teacher should be with students together and give instant guide during the whole training period. Although many computer aided calligraphic learning systems occurred to help people learn calligraphy. But these systems cannot give an instant evaluation to help people increase learning efficiency. In this paper we introduce a Chinese Calligraphic training system based on virtual reality by which learner can write on iPad screen to practice copying writing, virtual writing. The evaluation result of user's writing will be given using the skeleton matching and stroke order matching just after users finish writing. We use this system in some schools and the test result shows that it can improve the learning speed and interest.

articleTitle: Analysis of Adjacent Lane Interference in ETC System
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: To solve the problem of adjacent lane interference, there different ways were proposed. 1) modeled the ETC lane and established coordination system, method of boundary analysis was adopted to calculate the parameters for ETC lane. 2) D-S evidence theory was adopted to fuse the results of verification and make a final decision whether it was the right car to be charged 3) Used coherent demodulation method for reducing the signal of the adjacent lane, avoid the adjacent lane interference. The experimental results show that: 1) with reasonable installation conditions, set the ETC lane parameters, can guarantee the reliable trading in effective communication area. 2) Information fusion technology can highly reliably detect illegal vehicles and solve adjacent lane interference in ETC system, 3) Coherent demodulation method has large improvement in signal de-noising and system error rate.

Author Keywords: interference mode of lane and coordination

articleTitle: Research of Vehicle Recognition Method under SURF Feature and Bayesian Model
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper investigates the vehicle recognition method based on the SURF algorithm and Bayesian classification model. This method is robust for it overcomes the problems of picture quality and shooting angle. Through the unsupervised Bayesian machine learning method, the vehicle type of unknown pictures can be recognized and fallen under the best matching type. The result shows that the vehicle rate is between 60% and 70%. When the number of feature points is between 180 and 210, we get the best result. The scale of training set is extremely important for perfecting the feature point information. Generally think, the training set is the bigger, the better.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Static Test Method in C Source Code
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: To increase the output's accuracy and credibility of fast static analysis tool, this paper proposes a hierarchical static testing method of C program. The first level is to access static analysis tools with speed heavy proportion and generated the initial output of detection, the second level is extracted the program slicing of the initial test results based on the warning message. Warning program slicing is formalized abstraction into Boolean formula to solve by the SAT solver. It can determine the slicing true or false. The results of the first level and the second level are composited to improve the accuracy of the analytical tools. The experiment showed that the method could improve the accuracy and credibility a certain extent. It also could effectively reduce false positives.

articleTitle: The Research of Concessionaire Selection Based on an Improved Lowest Tariff Decision Model
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: BOT projects have been widely used in the past twenty years in the construction of infrastructure projects. Choosing a suitable concessionaire is the key of the project. Based on Particle Swarm Optimization, The study develops an improved lowest tariff decision model for choosing the best concessionaire. The model and algorithm demonstrate with a numerical example of a toll expressway BOT project. The solution derived from the concessionaire decision model can be helpful to develop infrastructure projects by BOT concession successfully.

articleTitle: Research on Case Representation Method Based on Image Information
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: According to the fact that it's more likely to consider the image as the field of knowledge, and the image has the features of intuitivism, ample content, no language limited and convenient for communicating internationally, this article use the case-based reasoning method to decrease the difficulty of obtaining the knowledge, and then propose the case representation method based on image information. We have studied the RGB color model and HSV color model, and then discuss the conversion formula between them. What's more, we have studied the method of extracting the image color characteristics as image case attributes' description, make a model of image case, and then make a case representation on the forest fire early warning image.

articleTitle: Acoustic Characteristics of Male and Female Voice in Mongolian Traditional Folk Long Song
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The Mongolian folk song is the most exquisite and typical cultural form and the artistic demonstration of the Mongolian's way of survival as well. Therefore, research on Mongolian folk songs is sure to enrich the arts treasury of all human beings. On the basis of traditional phonetics and with Mongolian long-tune as the study object, this paper analyzes the parameters we've got by the means of experimental phonetics, experiment equipment and voice function analysis software. As a consequence, we come to know the acoustic characteristics of male and female voice and get a large amount of physical and psychological parameter, which can play an active part in the exploit and protection of the long song and create a new research field.

articleTitle: A Method of TV Screen Shape Detection Based on Threshold Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Detecting the boundary of television screen is the basis of content identification for human-computer interaction. Uncertainty exists in TV video image which is captured by mobile phone because of the resolution, color, brightness, background. The reduction of image quality leads to inaccurate identification. We propose a method based on the feature of TV's shape to segment the TV screen indirectly. Our approach aims at extracting the typical feature between the background and objective image. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach for TV screen shape.

articleTitle: Adaptive Algorithm for Adjusting Weights in Multiple Attributes Group Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper studies weight adjustment in multiple attributes group decision making model. Firstly, the attribute weights respectively calculated by methods of AHP and entropy are optimized based on objective programming model. Secondly, the initial weights of decision-makers are updated by the grey correlation degree between the individual decision results and the group decision results. Furtherly, the group decision results are updated. Then the weight-adjusting is continued on the basis of the new group decision results. Based on 2-Norm Minkowski measure, the steady weights of decision-makers and final results of the group are gotten with the process of adjustment. Finally, a numerical example to evaluate wind power equipment supplier shows the feasibility and practicability of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Revised MCU-Assisted GPR Site Sampling Method and Its Application in Karst Development Detection
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In modern geophysical prospecting, GPR has been more and more widely used due to its accuracy and high efficiency. However, different site conditions and a rather strict demand for equal-distance reminding actually set limits on the traditional application method of GPR. In solving this problem, a new MCU-controlled equal-distance reminding device has been designed to form a new site sampling platform. With the reduction of the difficulties in equal-distance reminding as well as technical distortions, a revised more practical MCU-assisted GPR site sampling method has formed. The practical application case proves this method more efficient. Compared to the traditional method, the new one improves the sampling accuracy, diminishes positioning inaccuracy from movement and reduces limits set by the environment. In all, this new sampling method eases the process of detecting underground karst caves and improves the accuracy.

articleTitle: An Improved Evolutionary Multiobjective Service Composition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Evolutionary multi-objective service composition optimizer (E<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) is a recently proposed optimization framework for SLA-Aware service composition. It considers multiple SLAs simultaneously and produces a set of Pareto solutions. Two multi-objective genetic algorithms: E<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>-MOGA and Extreme-E<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> provided by E<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> have shown very good performance in comparison to NSGA-II. In this paper, an improved version of E<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>-MOGA, namely E<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>-IMOGA is proposed, which incorporates a fine-grained domination assignment value strategy. We evaluated our approach experimentally using dataset and compared with E<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>-MOGA and NSGA-II. It reveals promising results in terms of the quality of individuals and the time for finding all feasible individuals.

articleTitle: Function Projective Synchronization of Complex Dynamical Networks with Time-Varying Delay via Mixed Feedback Control
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In this paper, the problem on function projective synchronization is investigated for time-varying and without time-varying complex networks by using mixed control strategy. Together with some Lyapunov-Krasovskii functionals and effective mathematical techniques, several conditions are derived to guarantee a class of complex networks with time varying and without time-varying delays to be function projective synchronization. Finally, examples are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: How to Construct Personalized Cognitive Structures
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The learner's cognitive structure is the most important in the lots of factors affecting the efficiency of learning. For general problems currently existing in the individual learning, this paper proposes a method for constructing personalized cognitive structure. Through improving and perfecting Concept Maps the learner's cognitive structure and cognitive level could be represented formally. Then the Personalized Concept Map could be divided into layers according to the characteristics and patterns of knowledge acquisition i.e. from simple to complex, from easy to difficult. To build e-learning system with personalized concept mapping as a core can stay informed of the learner level, for the realization of personalized, intelligent learning system provides a strong foundation.

articleTitle: Research for Increasing Accuracy of IEEE1588 Protocol in the VLAN
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: IEEE1588 precision time protocol (PTP) is a time synchronization protocol that is specially designed for measurement and control field. It is widely used in many fields for high clock synchronization precision, strong stability, low cost etc. In this paper, we study how to make full use of VLAN tag field to improve PTP packets forwarding priority in the second layer switch supporting VLAN, so can reduce jitter and error caused by PTP packets in the network transmission and implement nanosecond precision.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Operational Effectiveness for TWS Based on Fuzzy Probability
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The operational effectiveness of torpedo weapon system (TWS) is exhibited in the process of attack-defense movement. According to the uncertainty of situation in using torpedo weapon system, a new dynamic-static evaluation effectiveness method (fuzzy probability) is proposed using fuzzy mathematics and AHP. The math model and arithmetic is presented, and the operational effectiveness of shipboard torpedo is analyzed. The result shows the efficiency of the method in evaluation for operational effectiveness of complex weapon system with fuzzy and uncertain dynamic-countermeasure characteristic.

articleTitle: A Self-Tuning Fuzzy Logic Controller for Superheat of Evaporator by Using Electronic Expansion Valve
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In this paper, a self-tuning fuzzy logic controller (STFLC) is proposed to maintain the evaporator superheat via an electronic expansion valve (EEV) in a vapor compression chiller system. The output scaling factor (SF) of the STFLC is tuned in an on-line manner by fuzzy rules according to the current condition of the process. To verify the performance of the proposed control scheme, real-time experiments have been conducted on a pilot vapor compression chiller system. The results demonstrate that the controller design outperforms its conventional counterpart in keeping the evaporator superheat at a desired value even when the refrigeration load is changed over a wide range.

articleTitle: User Experience of Social Network Based on a Cross-Platform Background
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The concept of cross-platform experience was put forward through user experience, social network theory, and user interviews. The research obtained four impacting elements of group experience: seamless connection, intelligent computation, evoking emotions and privacy. By questionnaire survey on Sina Weibo, different user traits of cross-platform experience were studied. Finally, the conclusion on group users experience system was drawn from qualitative to quantitative aspects.

articleTitle: Adaptive Parallel Genetic Algorithm for Expert Assignment Problem
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: As an evaluation method, peer review is used in many business fields. The quality of experts appointed will affect the results of the final evaluation since experts' expertise will have a direct impact on evaluation. This paper first analyzes the problem of expert assignment, then researches on its mathematical model and how to get the optimal Pareto, and finally discusses the feasibility of solving the problem of expert assignment through the application of genetic algorithms. It mainly discusses how to solve APGA in the expert assignment process, and then gives out the process of APGA solution to the problem. The test proved that the APGA can effectively solve expert assignment problem. The same time, and random search algorithm and genetic algorithm (SGA) to assign the results of APGA in the convergence speed and search ability has obvious advantages.

articleTitle: Kernel Uncorrelated Local Fisher Discriminant Analysis and Its Application to Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Local Fisher Discriminant Analysis (LFDA) achieves high performance for face recognition. However, LFDA is still a linear technique and usually deteriorates because the basis vectors of LFDA are statistically correlated. In this paper, we propose a Kernel Uncorrelated Local Fisher Discriminant Analysis (KULFDA), which can exploit the nonlinear and statistically uncorrelated features. A major advantage of the proposed method is that every column of the kernel matrix is regarded as a corresponding sample. Then nonlinear features can be extracted by performing ULFDA the in kernel matrix. Experimental results on ORL and YALE databases demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A General Model for the Data Plan of Virtual Router Based on NP
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Router virtualization allows multiple virtual router instances to run on the same physical platform. And high performance and flexible deployment are the main challenges for the design of virtual router. In this paper, we firstly analyze, discuss and illustrate the features and limitations of virtual router models that were proposed by many research communities for the support of virtual networks. Then, we put forward a general model for the data plan of virtual router which not only provides a Modules Database that can easily develop virtual routers to fulfill the requirement of service provider, but also has a similar kernel providing a series of standard APIs that can provide a good programming environment for software programmers who even know nothing of the underlying physical platform. Furthermore, we also analyze the challenges encountered and discuss the next works in the future.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Multispectral Images Compression Algorithm Based Distributed Compressive Sensing
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In this paper, we proposes a low-complexity and excellent multispectral images compression algorithm based distributed compressive sensing. 2-D lifting discrete wavelet transform (DWT) is applied to eliminate spatial redundancy of each band of multispectral images. Unlike the traditional wavelet-based coders (e.g., CCSDS-IDC, etc), DWT coefficients of each band here are not directly encoded, but the high-frequency sub-bands are re-sampled by a fast compressive sensing (CS) measurements. Then the resultant CS measurements of each band are encoded by means of distributed source coding. Experimental results show that the proposed compression algorithm obtains better compression performance compared with the relevant existing algorithms.

articleTitle: A New Method of Improving the Electric Field Distributions in Electro-optical Crystal Used in OVT
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper puts forward a new method of improving the electro-optic crystal's electric field distributions by attaching some kind of media on the electro-optical crystal. Through the simulation of a 110 kV OVT (Optical Voltage Transducer) the method is proved being effective in improving the distributions of electric field in crystal and reducing the measurement errors caused by an optical path offset and interference field. The improvement can ultimately increase the accuracy and stability of the OVT.

articleTitle: A Haptic Rendering Method in Medical Complex Scene
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The paper presents a haptic rendering method in medical complex scene. With the development of virtual surgery, the haptic interaction of virtual medical scene through a convenient way becomes an important requirement. On the one hand, our approach introduces an efficient mechanism to collect buffer in the process of marching cubes. On the other hand, an improved haptic camera view by culling with spatial partitioning is proposed to keep down the size of haptic rendering. Moreover, the dynamic proxy algorithm is introduced to calculate the contact force between haptic device and virtual object. Simulation results show that this method could achieve stable contact in medical complex scene.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Bee Colony Algorithms for Unsteady Aerodynamic Parameter Estimation
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: When the aircraft is in the state of the high angle of attack, the aerodynamic characteristics of the aircraft are rendered as non-linear and unsteady, therefore the aerodynamic model and the parameters in the model face higher requirements. To deal with the nonlinear and unsteady in the state of high angle of attack, this paper uses the artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm in the aerodynamic parameter estimation to replace the commonly used gradient algorithms. The simulation results show that ABC algorithm is an effective method in identifying the aerodynamic parameters in the high angle of attack.

articleTitle: Image Denoising and Enhancement with Evolutionary Programming in Wavelet Domain
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) digital images are often badly degraded by noise during dynamic acquisition and transmission process. Denoising is very important and difficult for UAV-vision Guided, because natural scene image is complicated and having lots of the edges and texture details. The image denoising and enhancement algorithm based on adaptive dual-tree discrete wavelet packets (ADDWP) which combine the dual-tree discrete wavelet packets and evolutionary programming is proposed in this paper. In order to reduce the noise and enhance detail for a UAV image by the EP (evolutionary programming) in wavelet domain. Firstly, The de-noising threshold is estimated by EP in the wavelet domain. Secondly, Noise is reduced in the fine high-frequency sub-bands of each decomposition level, respectively, so that the maximum signal-noise ratio can be obtained in the high-frequency sub bands, respectively. Thirdly, The enhancement parameters is estimated by EP in the wavelet domain, and the detail is adaptive enhanced by an improved non-linear gain operator in the coarse high-frequency sub bands of each decomposition level, respectively. The experiment result improves our algorithm is efficient.

articleTitle: Mass Information Index Design Based on MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: With the rapid development of social informatization, there is a lot of new data generated every day, the focus of the IT industry is how to quickly find out the information you need. Inverted index based on MapReduce technology can achieve rapid retrieval, and it is a common index structure in the index engine information retrieval systems. At the same time, mass data need to be in a distributed platform for storage and processing, the corresponding file inverted index structure also needs to be run in a distributed platform, and MapReduce is currently the most common used technology of inverted index structure. Mass information index based on MapReduce is quicker, more convenient and suitable than the traditional index.

articleTitle: The Research on Robot Control Based on Fuzzy Immune Technology
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: A new intelligent control method fuzzy control is used on the PID controller. PID control or the fuzzy PID control is hard to achieve the required control precision. The immune feedback system which develops from artificial immune system, has a strongly adaptive and stable ability is combined with the fuzzy control. The experiment result shows the fuzzy immune feedback system has a good control effect.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Risk Contagion Based on Agent Technology
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Under the condition of open economy, financial contagion channels become diverse and hidden, resulting in risk contagion with fast speed and wide range. Traditional methods with main characteristic of linear analysis, meet some troubles to analyze financial risk contagion because the complexities of financial markets are gradually strengthening nonlinear characteristics of asset prices. Agent technology based on CAS theory is very suitable for the study of nonlinear changes related parameters in financial markets. According to risk contagion theory and complexity ideology, the proposed agent modeling method reflects the mechanism of risk contagion among economies.

articleTitle: A View-Dependent Stereoscopic System Using Tiled Projection
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel system which allows its users to see a stereoscopic virtual object. Unlike most existing stereoscopic systems that display the same imagery when watched from different directions, the user's head is tracked in real-time so that the real-time images can be rendered according to the viewing position, which enables the dynamic images to be displayed on the screen and the users can see different parts of a virtual object when wearing a pair of polarized glasses. This creates a more vivid illusion that a real object is set at the physical scene. The key technologies of the proposed system such as depth-image-based head tracking, geometric calibration and view-dependent real-time stereoscopic image rendering are studied and the experimental results proves the performance of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Transportation Scheduling Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In the public transport scheduling, the problem of transferring buses in stations becomes more and more important. Therefore, many people begin to research the number of the encountered buses. This work elaborates that how to ensure more encountered buses in a station, which can make it convenient to transfer buses. In this paper we build a model to optimize the buses transferring in one area. The model considers the changing of the time that one bus remains in a station, which can affect the encounter of two buses. And the model has a variable number which describes the resident time of one bus in a station and two objective functions that one is the number of the encountered buses and the other is the number of stations in which buses encounter. It calculates the maximum of the number of the encountered buses and the min of the number of encountered stations. In this way, it ensures the best departure time of all routes. So that it makes the cost and the time to transfer buses become less. In addition, it calculates the value by using the algorithm optimization. Through the experiment result, we can see that this algorithm can improve the efficiency of riding buses and the level of the services in the field of public transport.

articleTitle: Situation Assessment Based on Group Decision and Rule Fusion
publicationTitle: 2013 Sixth International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Evidence theory is one of the main methods to achieve rule-based situational awareness. However, in the combination of multiple sources, the theory of evidence can result in paradox. To resolve this problem, a situation assessment fusion method based on group decision making and rules fusion is proposed. The method includes three stages, which are the measurement of rules importance, rules fusion based on improved evidence theory and situational decision-making. Experimental results show that this method can avoid the paradox, the fusion efficiency and accuracy is superior to existing typical method.
